entities.paper: A Readable Read: Automatic Assessment of Language Learning Materials based on Linguistic Complexity

feature_sources.text: The features were developed based on information from previous literature and a grammar book for Swedish L2 learners.

length_based.text: Length-based features include sentence length in number of tokens and characters, extra-long words (longer than thirteen characters), and the traditional Swedish readability formula LIX.

lexical.text: Lexical features use the Kelly list (CEFR level and frequencies per lemma), incidence scores per 1000 words, incidence of words at each CEFR level, tokens above the text/sentence CEFR level, tokens not in the Kelly list, lemmatizer failures, and average log frequencies.

morphological.text: Morphological features include variation and incidence scores of lexical categories, punctuations, particles, sub- and conjunctions, inflectional information such as neuter gender nouns and verb form ratios, bilogarithmic and square root TTR, nominal ratio, pronoun-to-preposition ratio, lexical density features, and relative structures.

syntactic.text: Syntactic features are based on dependency arc length (depth) and direction, incidence of relative clauses in clefts, and incidence of pre- and postmodifiers such as adjectives and prepositional phrases.

semantic.text: Semantic features rely on SALDO, a Swedish lexical-semantic resource, using the average number of senses per token and the average number of noun senses per noun.

nlp_tools_general.text: The introduction notes that linguistic features explored for readability incorporate information from part-of-speech taggers and dependency parsers, and that cognitively motivated features have been proposed (e.g., Coh-Metrix).

feature_utility.text: Using word-frequency features alone was almost as predictive as combining all features at the document level, but the full feature set gave 7% higher accuracy at the sentence level.

feature_subgroups.text: 论文的特征集分为五个子组：length-based、lexical、morphological、syntactic 和 semantic 特征。

length_based_features.text: Length-based 特征包括句子长度（以 token 数和字符数计）、超长词（超过十三个字符）以及传统瑞典语可读性公式 LIX；在句子级分析中，作者使用单个句子中的 token 数而非 token 数与句子数之比。

lexical_features.text: Lexical 特征使用 Kelly 词表（提供每个词元的 CEFR 等级与频率，且独立于其数据集），采用每 1000 词的 incidence score 而非百分比，计算各 CEFR 等级词的 IncSc、高于文本或句子 CEFR 等级的词作为难词、未出现在 Kelly 词表中的 token、未找到词元的 token 以及平均对数频率。

morphological_features.text: Morphological 特征包括各词类及标点、小品词、从属与并列连词的 IncSc，以及基于 L2 教材洞察的细粒度屈折信息（如中性名词的 IncSc、不同动词形式占全部动词的比例）；此外用双对数和平方根 TTR 替代简单 TTR，并纳入名词比率、代词与介词之比及两个词汇密度特征。

syntactic_features.text: Syntactic 特征部分基于依存弧的长度（深度）与方向，并补充了 cleft 中关系从句的 IncSc 以及前置和后置修饰语（如形容词和介词短语）的 IncSc。

semantic_features.text: Semantic 特征基于瑞典语词汇语义资源 SALDO，使用每个 token 的平均义项数以及每个名词的平均名词义项数。

document_level_subgroup_performance.text: 文档级实验中，LIX 准确率很低且将 91.6% 的实例归为 B2；单独使用时，length-based、semantic 和 syntactic 特征表现与基线相近或仅略好，因此被排除在 Table 9 之外，而 lexical 特征具有较强区分力。

document_level_lexical_only.text: 仅用 lexical 特征达到与完整特征集大致相同的性能（0.8 F 对 All 的 0.81 F）；完整特征集获得 81% 准确率和 97% 相邻准确率，仅 lexical 特征为 80.3% 准确率和 98% 相邻准确率。

sentence_level_feature_combination.text: 作者报告，在句子级，与仅用 lexical 特征相比，组合使用不同特征使分类准确率提升 7%；而在文档级，lexical 特征更为主导。

overall_performance.text: 模型在文档级获得 81.3% 准确率和 0.8 F-score；句子级五分类模型获得 63.4% 准确率和 92% 相邻准确率。

lix_comparison.text: 与瑞典语广泛使用的可读性指标 LIX 相比，作者报告在准确率和 F-score 上分别取得 46% 和 0.6 的提升。

multiple_dimensions_usefulness.text: 作者指出，在评估语言复杂度时考虑多个语言维度对句子级分析尤其有用；仅用词频特征在文档级几乎与全部特征组合一样具有预测力，但后者对句子预测更准确。
